correctness.rationale: Definitions and all 26 triples for each Steiner system are given. Exhaustive 2^13-face enumeration and pair uniqueness checks are independently replayable. Deterministic face-poset acyclic matchings exhaust every oriented incidence; critical-cell counts give a reduced CW model with only dimensions zero, three and four. The signed integral critical boundary has explicit determinants +1 on full-rank minors, proving split-surjective integral attaching maps and free H4 of ranks 12 and 17. Three-connectedness, Hurewicz and homology Whitehead give homotopy equivalences. The cyclic character is proved using nontrivial translation-fixed simplices and reduced Lefschetz trace. All of these steps are reproduced by the included verifier; modular checks alone are not treated as integral proof.

value.rationale: The two isomorphism types of the smallest order with nonunique Steiner triple systems constitute a canonical complete comparison. Their different integral wedge-of-four-spheres homotopy types and precise five-sphere trade shift are structural, not merely Euler characteristics or face counts. The nonpure combinatorial complexes have strongly constrained homotopy and the cyclic instance has a full rational C13 augmentation character. The exact attaching maps solve a motivated topological gap left open by published enumeration.
